description: This file defines a custom React component 'Field' for rendering paired text fields and a 'controller' function for managing their state within a Keystone schema, including serialization/deserialization logic and GraphQL selection.

methods.name: Field
methods.description: A React component rendering two text fields for editing 'left' and 'right' string or null values, with labels and descriptions derived from the 'field' prop.

methods.name: controller
methods.description: A factory function creating a field controller for serialization, deserialization, and GraphQL selection based on provided configuration.

calls: onChange?.({ left: x === '' ? null : x, right })
onChange?.({ right: x === '' ? null : x, left })
